title: 136 Silver Laurel | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Pet Friendly + Walking Distance to Watercolor Beach Club and Beach Access- 136 Silver Laurel by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 136 Silver Laurel Way by Royal Destinations Location: WaterColor Phase One on Rainbow Row Address: 136 Silver Laurel Way, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Conveniently located two blocks from the new Gulf front WaterColor Beach Club and nestled between the village centers of WaterColor and Seaside, the newly remodeled 136 Silver Laurel is within walking distance to all attractions. This WaterColor beach vacation rental is a charming yet spacious cottage designed for friends and family to gather in the open concept floor plan with first and second floor suites. The second floor is comprised of a spacious living area and kitchen. The gourmet kitchen boasts granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a breakfast bar, and a dining area. Also located upstairs is the primary bedroom, featuring a king-sized bed and an attached private bath. Enjoy the Florida weather while relaxing in this WaterColor vacation rental's covered porch or cruise over to Seaside on one of the 6 complimentary adult bikes. Don't forget to bring your four-legged family members, as this home is pet-friendly! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Located in WaterColor's Park District - *Pet Friendly with approval - Distance to WaterColor Beach Club: 7-Minute Walk (2-Minute Bike Ride) - 10-minute walk to Seaside (Shopping, Dining, Activities, Etc.) - Fully Equipped Gourmet Kitchen - Large Covered Porch - 6 Adult Bikes - 2 Dedicated Parking Spots *Additional Fee Applicable $350 each (pre-tax) *Please contact Reservations for approval prior to your stay. WaterColor Community Highlights: - Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S. - WaterColor provides a free, on-demand trolley for guests, available daily with seasonal hours through the WaterColor Trolley app. For more information, contact our Reservations Team. - A 499-Acre Coastal Resort and Residential Community - Bike Community - Award-Winning Tennis Facilities - Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining - Nearby State Parks and Preserves - 4 Swimming Pools Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 5 Bedrooms / 3 Full Baths / 1 Half Baths First Floor: - Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo, Deck and Patio, Smart TV - Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower, Deck and Patio, Smart TV - Guest Bedroom 3: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower, Smart TV - Guest Bedroom 4: Bunk Room: Two Twin/Twin Bunks, Shared Bathroom with Shower, Smart TV - Laundry Room Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 5: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub, Balcony, Smart TV Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore!
